verdict.rationale: Vendor docs claim that BILL Spend & Expense cards make every transaction 'controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant' and pair with AI-driven bill coding (docs-8, docs-9), plus automatic 2-way sync to major accounting systems (docs-12), which supports real-time coding for close. However, there is no explicit documentation of automatic merchant/memo capture or receipt-matching workflows, and no independent/hands-on evidence corroborating that categorization actually eliminates manual review at month-end. Missing for 10: explicit receipt-capture/matching evidence, memo-field automation detail, and independent verification of coding accuracy.
